The dream-monsters were best fought with weapons that struck down the spirit, rather than the flesh. | crafting = Stormreaver Monument{{Extra|2|Dreamforge}} | craftingupgrade = | pic = Dreamspitter shown.jpg | picdesc = Dreamspitter.png | tips =
* Pre U12 versions missing Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver) can have this added via the Stormreaver Monument with 5 Ancient Elven Relics. Existing upgrades (Holy, Force Damage Ritual, etc.) are maintained. * Some old versions of the Dreamspitter do not have the Suppressed Power. This cannot be added, but you can add Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver) and then Force Burst. * The negative levels inflicted by a critical hit from Dreamspitter reduce the victim's saving throws, and that effect stacks with itself. * Dreamspitter becomes Bound to Character once the suppressed power is unlocked, but remains Bound to Account when the Stormreaver Seal upgrade is applied. With the application of the [[Seal of the Stormreaver]] and a [[Crystal Disk of Dreams]], this weapon can be upgraded to: [[File:Dreamspitter (upgraded).png|center|Upgraded & Unsuppressed Version]] }} [[C:Eleven Year Old Cake items]] [[Category:Draconic Raider's Reward Box items]]
